body.head: Indian Methodist Hymn-book / Hymns Used on the Fraser River Indian Mission, of the Methodist Church, B. C. Conference, to Which Are Appended Hymns in Chinook, and the Lord's Prayer and Ten Commandments

div.head:
INDIAN
Methodist Hymn-Book
Staylim=Paypa ta Methodist=Ts’hayilth.

lg.l: Rev’s. Thos. Crosby, Chas. M Tate,
and Wm. H Barraclough, B.A., Missionaries.

div.p:
Compiled and Printed by Rev. W.H. Barraclough,
Chilliwack, B.C. 1898.

div.head: NOTES
div.p: The following hymns are in the Chill-way-uk dialect of the language of the Alkomaylum nation of Indians, who live along the Fraser River, from Yale to the Coast, and on Vancouver Island, at Cowichan and Nanaimo. The Alkomaylum, (or Ankomeenum, sometimes called Stawlo or River language,) as spoken by the Cowichans, is sweet and rythmical. The Chillwayuk dialect is harsher and more guttural. The Nanaimos, the Yales, the Sumas, the Kwantuls, etc. of B.C., and the Nooksaks of Wash., U.S.A., each speak a slightly different dialect of the same language.

div.head: ⇒ PRONUNCIATION.
div.p: ` When before k, sound the letter by pressing the back of the tongue against the soft palate, and expelling the letter with a clicking sound. When before t, ts, or tz, press the tip of the tongue against the hard palate, and expel the sound as before.
kh, Is sounded by lightly pressing the back of the tongue against the soft palate, and emitting the sound in a slurring manner.
tl, and lth, Are sounded by pressing the tip of the tongue against the hard palate and emit as in kh.
a, Is pronounced ah; while all others are regular as in English.
T.C., C.M.T., and W.H.B., at the end of each hymn, are the initials of the translators.

div.head:
1
ARISE MY SOUL ARISE.
Canadian Hymnal No. 72.

lg.l: S’khayl talswal skwikh lay ta tchalikhs.
Before the throne my surety stands;
My name is written on his hands.

div.head:
2
WE’LL WORK TILL JESUS COMES.
Gospel Hymns 1-6 Complete No. 180.

lg.l: Lay ta ay-e tumokh al stlay-kwus ka-wom,
Ay-e-kwus see-ize ka tatsel ta Jesus,
Lay-wilth kukh ta ay-e mestayokh lay,
Kla al stlay-kwus lam kwatsit toklalim
Owa-tcha staas lay ta ay-e tumokh,
O land of rest, for thee I sigh,
When I shall lay my armor by,
And dwell in peace at home.

div.head:
3
I AM SO GLAD THAT OUR FATHER.
G.H. 1-6 No. 18.

lg.l: Hayluk tal skwilawal tal mal lay ta tchee-tchilth,
Shkha-khayl taswas skwell tokla may awkwus-thawmikh,
Kukh ta ay-e stem shkha-khayl lay taswas skwell
Kla ewal ay-e tokla Jesus stlay-il-thawmikh.

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 I am so glad that our Father in Heaven

lg.l: Tells of His love in the Book He has given,
Wonderful things in the Bible I see,
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.
||: I am so glad that Jesus loves me, :||

div.p: 2 Though I forget Him and wander away,
Still He doth love me wherever I stray;
Back to His dear loving arms would I flee,
When I remember that Jesus loves me.
3 Jesus loves me, and I know I love Him,
Love brought Him down my poor soul to redeem.
Yes! it was love made Him die on the tree,
Oh! I am certain that Jesus loves me.

div.head:
4
COME THOU FOUNT.
Can. Hym’l, No. 218.

lg.l: Sta-a kwo stawlo taswas ay-e skwilawal,
Al stlay ta Jesus osthayte tal skwell;

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Come, thou Fount of every blessing,

lg.l: Tune my heart to sing thy grace,
Call for songs of loudest praise.

div.p: Oh, the vast, the boundless treasure,

lg.l: Lay kwa tchee-tchilth ta ay-e tumokh,
Lay kwa tchee-tchilth ta ay-e staylim,
Tchalal kwus staylim skaka ta ay-e mes-tayokh,
Lamtcha hi owe-awts may kulth skwilawal,
Skwi kwuls kham lam al-tus ay-e lalam.

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 There’s a land that is fairer than day,

lg.l: And by faith we can see it afar,
For the Father waits over the way,
To prepare us a dwelling place there.
We shall meet on that beautiful shore. :||

div.p: 2 We shall meet, we shall sing, we shall reign
In the land where the saved never die;
We shall rest free from sorrow and pain,
Safe at home in the sweet by-and-bye.

div.head:
6
THY WILL BE DONE.
G.H. 1-6 No. 229.
ENGLISH
div.p: 1 My God and Father, while I stray
Far from my home, on life’s rough way,
Oh, teach me from my heart to say,
2 What tho’ in lonely grief I sigh
For friends beloved, no longer nigh,
3 Renew my will from day to day,
Blend it with thine, and take away
All that now makes it hard to say,

lg.l: Tchalal-e ka wom lay ta tchee-tchilth tumokh.
Al stlay kwus makh tokla lee-awm,
Tchalal kwuls tsats-aye lay ta tchee-tchilth,
When I can read my title clear
I’ll bid farewell to every fear,

div.head:
8
NOTHING BUT THE BLOOD OF JESUS.
G. H. 1-6 No. 195.
ALKOMAYLUM
div.p: Owa tlaws ta ay-e talswal see-ize.

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 What can wash away my stain,

lg.l: Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
That makes me white as snow;
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

div.p: Naught of good that I have done.

div.head:
9
HOLY SPIRIT, FAITHFUL GUIDE.
Can. Hym’l. No. 20.

lg.l: Gently lead us by the hand,
While they hear that sweetest voice,
Follow me, I’ll guide thee home.’

div.head:
10
STAND UP FOR JESUS.
Can. Hym’l No. 195.

lg.l: Stand up! stand up for Jesus!

div.head:
11
THERE IS A FOUNTAIN.
G. H. 1-6 No. 733.
ENGLISH
div.p: 1 There is a fountain filled with blood,
And sinners, plunged beneath that flood,
2 The dying thief rejoiced to see
And there may I, though vile as he
3 O dying Lamb, thy precious blood
Till all the ransomed Church of God
Be saved to sin no more.

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Jesus shall reign where’er the sun
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till suns shall rise and set no more.
2 For him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown his head;
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
3 Let every creature rise, and bring
Its grateful honors to our King;
And earth prolong the joyful strain.

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: Kindle a flame of sacred love
In these cold hearts of ours.
2 In vain we tune our formal songs,
In vain we strive to rise;
Come, shed abroad the Savior’s love,

lg.l: Let me to thy bosom fly,
While the tempest still is high:
Hide me, oh, my Saviour, hide,
Till the storm of life be past;
Oh, receive my soul at last.

div.head:
15
THERE IS A LAND OF PURE DELIGHT.
Can. Hym’l, No. 254.
ENGLISH
div.p: 1 There is a land of pure delight
Death, like a narrow sea, divides
3 Could we but climb where Moses stood,
Not Jordan’s stream, nor death’s cold flood,
Should fright us from the shore.

div.head:
16
JESUS, THE NAME HIGH OVER ALL.
Can. Hym’l, No. 8.
ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Jesus! the name high over all,
In hell, or earth, or sky;
Angels and men before it fall,
2 Jesus! the name to sinners dear,
It scatters all their guilty fear,
It turns their hell to heaven.
Power into strengthless souls it speaks,

div.head:
17
COME EVERY SOUL BY SIN OPPRESSED.
Can. Hym’l No. 54.

lg.l: May ta Jesus, may ta Jesus,
Ayek’s muktchit lam ta ts’khwum stawlo,

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Come, every soul by sin oppressed,

lg.l: And he will surely give you rest
Only trust him, only trust him,
He will save you, he will save you,

div.p: 2 For Jesus shed his precious blood
Plunge then into the crimson flood

div.head:
18
TELL IT TO JESUS.
Can. Hym’l No. 37.
ALKOMAYLUM

lg.l: Aytchuh tl’jeuse whulam ta whuta skwilawal?
Haysest ta Jesus, haysest ta Jesus;
Aytchuh kham whulam ta ay-elth skwilawal?

div.p: Ay makwu`tl ta skas lay ta sa-at-ses?
Aytchuh kwilalt ta skwaw-kwult kul see-ize?

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Are you weary, are you heavy hearted?

lg.l: Tell it to Jesus, tell it to Jesus;
Are you grieving over joys departed?
Tell it to Jesus, tell it to Jesus,
He is a friend well known;
You have no other such a friend or brother,

div.p: 2 Do the tears flow down your cheeks unbidden?
Have you sins that to man’s eyes are hidden?
3 Are you troubled at the thought of dying?
For Christ’s coming kingdom are you sighing?

div.head:
19
SHALL WE GATHER AT THE RIVER.
Can. Hym’l, No. 239.

lg.l: Whaw-ay-e-im ta kas ta tchee-tchilth stawla,
Skaka ta ay-e mestayokh lay ta stawlo,
Tchalal telthlemelth tus ta ay-e stawlo,
Tchalal lay hi ta sawlth see-ize;

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Shall we gather at the river,

lg.l: Flowing by the throne of God.
Yes, we’ll gather at the river,
Gather with the saints at the river,
That flows by the throne of God.

div.p: 2 Soon we’ll reach the silver river,
Soon our happy hearts will quiver

div.head:
20
HERE WE SUFFER GRIEF AND PAIN.

lg.l: When we shall meet to part no more.

div.head:
21
NEARER MY GOD TO THEE.
Can. Hym’l No. 216.

lg.l: E’en though it be a cross
Still all my song shall be,

div.head:
22
COME, COME TO JESUS.
G.H. 1-6 No. 388.

23
JESUS, MY ALL, TO HEAVEN IS GONE.

lg.l: Maytla tl’welop lam, talsa stlay lam
Kla ke-a’tl ta otat ay-e mestayokh,

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Jesus, my all, to heaven is gone,

lg.l: He whom I fix my hopes upon;
His track I see, and I’ll pursue,
The narrow way, till him I view.
I’m going home, I’m going home,
I’m going home to die no more;
To die no more, to die no more,
I’m going home to die no more.

div.p: 2 The way that holy prophets went,
The road that leads from banishment,
I’ll go, for all his paths are peace.

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice;
Him serve with mirth, his praise forth tell,
Come ye before him, and rejoice.
2 Know that the Lord is God indeed,
Without our aid he did us make;
We are his flock, he doth us feed,
And for his sheep he doth us take.

div.head:
25
HOW FIRM A FOUNDATION.
Can. Hym’l No. 51.

lg.l: Lo hayluk tal skwilawal whulam talowa;
Lo hayluk tal skwilawal whulam talowa;
Ay-e-ilth tatsel ta Jesus, whimay tila tumokh,
Lam kulstokh tal skwilawal whulam ta ay-e se-ize.
How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord,
Is laid for your faith in his excellent word!
What more can he say, than to you he hath said,
To you, who for refuge to Jesus have fled?
“Fear not, I am with thee; oh, be not dismayed!
For I am thy God, I will still give thee aid;
I’ll strengthen thee, help thee, and cause thee to stand,
Upheld by my gracious, omnipotent hand.
“When through the deep waters I call thee to go,
The rivers of sorrow shall not overflow;
For I will be with thee thy trials to bless,
And sanctify to thee thy deepest distress.”

div.head:
27
’TIS THE PROMISE OF GOD.
G.H. 1-6 No. 5.

lg.l: O `kal al ta Jesus swas mellas tokla.

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 ’Tis the promise of God full salvation to give
Unto him who on Jesus, his son will believe.
I am saved by the blood of the crucified one. :||
2 Tho’ the pathway be lonely, and dangerous too,
Surely Jesus is able to carry me through.
3 Many loved ones have I in yon heavenly throng,
They are safe now in glory and this is their song.
4 Little children I see standing close by their king,
And He smiles as their song of salvation they sing.
5 There’s a part in that chorus for you and for me
And the theme of our praises forever shall be.

div.head:
28
ANGELS HOVERING AROUND.
Songs of Salvation No. 243.
ALKOMAYLUM
div.p: 2 Lamtcha kwe stukh ta ay-e skwulkwul,
4 Kukh mestayokh kwod stlay ta ay-e.

div.head:
29
COME TO JESUS.
G. H. 1-6 No. 720.

30
OH I AM SO HAPPY IN JESUS.
G. H. 1-6 No. 147.

lg.l: O hayluk tal skwilawal ta Jesus,
May hayluk tal skwilawal kwus staylim,
O hayluk tal skwilawal ta Jesus,
Lay hi stukh ta kul skwilawal;
O hayluk tal skwilawal ta Jesus,

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Oh, I am so happy in Jesus,

lg.l: His blood has redeemed me from sin,
I weep and I sing in my gladness,
To know He is dwelling within.
Oh, I am so happy in Jesus,
From sin and from sorrow so free;
So happy that He is my Saviour,
So happy that Jesus loves me.

div.p: 2 Oh, I am so happy in Jesus,
If earth in His love is so blest,
What joy in His glorified presence,
To sit at His feet as His guest.

lg.l: Hayluk tal skwilawal ta ay-e tumokh,
O kukh ta see-aya tchit lay.
How happy every child of grace
This earth, he cries, is not my place,
I seek my place in heaven.
Lamtchiltcha ska Jesus, tal Savior, lamtchiltcha,
Ayekwus lamtchil lay ta aye ke-a’tl lay tomuk swile
Tchallal-tcha tl’whuluk whulam ta aye tumokh
Muk eltchal kwus ewis lamtchiltcha tokla.
Follow, follow, I will follow Jesus,
Anywhere, everywhere, I will follow on;
Follow, follow, I will follow Jesus,
Anywhere he leads me, I will follow on.

div.head:
33
I WILL TELL IT TO JESUS MY LORD.
Can. Hym’l No. 351.

lg.l: Lamtchil haysest ta Jesus, tal see-am;
Lamtchil haysest ta Jesus, tal see-am.
Ta etila tumokh owe-awts kulth skwilawal,
Ka o mays tawtaylth-sthawm tokla lee-awm
Lamtchil haysest ta Jesus, tal see-am.
When times of temptation bring sadness and gloom
I will tell it to Jesus my Lord;
The last of earth’s treasures borne out to the tomb,
I will tell it to Jesus, my Lord.
This earth hath no sorrow for to-day or to-morrow,
But Jesus hath known it and felt long ago,
And when it comes o’er me, and I’m tempted so sorely,
I will tell it to Jesus, my Lord.
I will tell it to Jesus,

div.head:
34
O HAPPY DAY.
Can. Hym’l. No. 231.

lg.l: Ta Tchee-tchilth See-am, talswal lay Mal;

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Oh, happy day that fixed my choice
On thee, my Savior and my God!

lg.l: Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
And tell its raptures all abroad.
When Jesus washed my sins away.
He taught me how to watch and pray,
When Jesus washed my sins away.

div.p: I am my Lord’s, and he is mine;
He drew me, and I followed on,
Charmed to confess the voice divine.

div.head:
35
NOW THE CHAINS OF SIN ARE BROKEN.
Songs of Salvation No. 136.
ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Now the chains of sin are broken,
Christ the word of power has spoken
2 I will tell the wondrous story
He hath filled my soul with glory,

div.head:
36
PRECIOUS SAVIOR THOU DOST SAVE ME

lg.l: Ay-e tal skwilawal whulam ta Jesus;

div.head: ENGLISH
div.p: 1 Precious Savior, thou dost save me—
Thine, and only thine, I am—
Oh, the cleansing blood has reached me;
Oh, the cleansing blood has reached me,
2 Yes, I will stand up for Jesus,
He has sweetly saved my soul;
Cleansed my soul from sin’s corruption,

lg.l: Staylim ta tl-welop lay ta Tchee-tchilth,
Hytch ta Mals, ta Mellas, e ta Holy Spirit.

div.head: ENGLISH

lg.l: Praise God, from whom all blessings flow;
Praise him, all creatures here below;
Praise him above, ye heavenly host;
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.

div.p: “Kwus-litelth whul-ay ta kul see-ize, tokla Jesus `kie whimay telth-le-melth.”
“Kahta-laylie nes-ika ma-mook masat-chie, Jesus yahka chako mem-a-loos kopa ne-sika.”
“While we were yet sinners, Christ died for us,” Romans, 5, 8.

lg.l: Nika nem tzum kopa yahka le-mah.

div.head:
39
HAVE YOU BEEN TO JESUS.

lg.l: Spose mika tik-ke klap klosh tumtum,
Alkie mika klosh kopa kon-away sun,
Mamook halo masat-chie kopa mika tumtum

div.p: Spose mika tikke koolie kopa Jesus way-hut,
Yahka tikke mika kwansum koolie delate.

div.head:
40
WHAT CAN WASH AWAY MY STAIN.

41
NOW THE CHAINS OF SIN ARE BROKEN.

1
Follow, follow, I will follow Jesus.

lg.l: Kahta yaka elip koolie nika kimta.
Klosh mika waw-waw, klosh mika waw-waw

div.head:
3
Help me, dear Savior, Thee to own.

lg.l: Oh, Jesus, klosh spose mika help,

div.head: THE LORD’S PRAYER.
div.p: Our Father, which art in heaven, Hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, And forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

div.head: The Lord’s Prayer in Chinook.
div.p: Nesika Papa, mitlite kopa saghalie, klosh spose konaway tilikum mamook praise Mika nem; klosh spose konaway tilikum mamook tyee mika; klosh spose konaway tilikum kopa okook illahie mamook Mika tumtum, kaw-kwa klaska mamook kopa saghalie-illahie. Okook sun, pe konaway-sun potlatch nesika muk-amuk; pe klosh mika mash okook ma-sa-tchie nesika mamook kopa mika, kaw-kwa nesika mash okook ma-sa-tchie hul-oi-ma tilikum mamook kopa nesika; pe klosh mika mamook help nesika, spose halo-ikta tolo nesika kopa masatchie; pe klosh mika mamook haul nesika spose halo nesika chako kla-how-yum. Klosh spose kawkwa.

div.head: The Lord’s Prayer in Alkomaylum.
div.p: Sawlth Mal, lay kwa tchee-tchilth, ay-e-tcha kwus kwaw-kwa-tchits tomuk mes-tayokh taswas skwikh e-wal ay-e; ay-e-tcha-kwus tomuk mestayokh kwus titheet talowa e-wal See-am; ay-e-tcha-kwus tomuk mestayokh e-tila tumokh, kwus staa-stokh taswas skwilawal staa ta mes-tay-okh lay ta tchee-tchilth tumokh. Awkwus-tawlokh til-alth-le-melth kwus elth-til tila wile; ay-e mela-kul-is-tchuh tasawlth kul-see-ize, staa-tcha-staa mela-kul-is-tchit ta kul-skwi-it-tawlokh ta ow la`tz mes-tay okh; ay-e kwawm-kwum-tchuh tila sawlth skwi-la-wal kwus owa-tchit at ow kwulam ta kul; ay-e-kwus kee-awt’la-mit-taw-lokh kwus owa-tchit tasos-it.

div.head: THE TEN COMMANDMENTS.
div.p: 1 Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

2 Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth; thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me; and showing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
3 Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

4 Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy. Six days shalt thou labor and do all thy work: but the seventh is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy man-servant, nor thy maid-servant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
5 Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
9 Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor.
10 Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbor’s wife, nor his man-servant, nor his maid-servant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor anything that is thy neighbor’s.

div.head: The Ten Commandments in Chinook.
div.p: 2 Wake mika iskum ikta spose mamook Saghalie-Tyee yaka.
3 Wake mika mamook kultus yaka nem Saghalie Tyee.
5 Klosh nannitsh mika papa pe mika mamma.
7 Wake mika ma-mook ma-sat-chic kona-moxt klootchman.
10 Wake mika mamook tumtum spose mika kepswalla huloima tilikum klaska klootchman pe iktas.

div.head: The Ten Commandments in Alkomaylum.
div.p: 2 Owa-tchuh ee-ise-okh kwa stem staa kwa T-S.
3 Owa-tchuh kal-kul-aylth-okh ta skwikhs kwa Tchee-tchilth-See-am.
5 Ay-e-skwas kwaw-kwa-tchit taswa lay mal, ka taswa lay tal.
8 Owa-tchuh kwus kal kwa stem tilay kwa latcha.
10 Owa-tchuh kwus kwolkwul-aywal kwus sthee-its-tul, ka kwus kal kwus stem.
